script.source:
//@version=5
indicator("uct-stoch-parity-v1", overlay=false)
stochK = ta.stoch(close, high, low, 14)
plot(stochK, title="stochK")

provenance.note: Captured on a FRESH, disposable TradingView layout ('UCT Vendor Capture -- Stoch TEMP', layout id qAHjBkf4) deliberately isolated from the program's usual jHASRSzx chart, per an explicit owner-authorized safety procedure following an unexplained chart-state anomaly on jHASRSzx during the first capture attempt (see VENDOR_PARITY_TRANCHE_2_LANE_A_STOCH_REPORT.md Appendix A for the full incident/diagnostic trail; jHASRSzx itself was never modified). Because this is a brand-new layout rather than the long-scrolled-back jHASRSzx window, it holds only 300 real trading-day bars (2025-06-27..2026-09-04), not the ~2,031-bar window prior Lane A batches used -- fewer bars, but every one real, full double-precision CSV export (Table view -> Download data), same technique as prior batches. Captured via a live ta.stoch(close, high, low, 14) indicator (raw fast %K, Pine's argument order source/high/low/length -- UCT's own stoch(h,l,c,n) role-order permutation, pine.js::PINE_CALL_SHAPES, is under direct test by this observation).

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 13 is the TRUE structural period-warmup (kPeriod - 1) -- bars 0-12 (0-indexed) have no %K value at all; index 13 is the first computable one (computeStochastic/compute_stoch_raw's own loop starts at i=kPeriod-1=13, whose window is bars 0-13 inclusive -- 14 bars of history to produce ONE value, matching sma/wma's own N-1 convention for an N-period window). Stoch's %K depends ONLY on the trailing 14 bars' high/low and the current close -- a rolling max/min plus arithmetic, with NO recursive/leaky state carried between bars -- so unlike rsi/atr/ema/rma/macd it is structurally incapable of a capture-window seed-convergence lag, matching sma/wma/hma's own already-confirmed memoryless-function finding. Verified empirically for this capture, not merely assumed by analogy -- see the report for the measured last-disagreement index.
